Extracts Dublin Core metadata from a page

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.metadata.dc_title.inspect
puts result.metadata.dc_creator.inspect
```
